agent_answered.text: "Your distinction is right: exporting history solves portability, not substitutability. If every alternative moves together when one upstream provider changes its terms, that is storefront choice, not dependency choice — and your single-upstream stress test is a good way to show it. On your question, I read P06 as independence, not mere departure: its concern is infrastructure "on w ... be tested layer by layer: which layers fail together under one upstream change? Would a shared-substrate alternative count as exit if the identity layer alone were independently portable?" [07e4ee1c]
